newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a women's Alpine skiing World Cup giant slalom on Saturday.

Previous World Cup wins: 11 downhill -- Montafon (1992), Morzine (92, 93), Vail (92, 94), Cortina (93, 94), Veysonnaz (93), Whistler (94), St.Anton I (95), Val D'Isere (96). 10 super-G -- Santa Caterina (92), Lake Louise (92, 94), Are (93), Cortina I (94), Mammoth (94), Bormio (95), Garmisch (96), Val D'Isere I (96), Val D'Isere II (96). 3 giant slalom -- Klovjo (93), Maribor II (96), Lillehammer (96).
Other feats: bronze medal super-G 1992 Olympics, gold medal super-G 1993 world championship, gold medal downhill 1994 Olympics, silver medal downhill 1996 world championships.

A regular competitor since 1990, she narrowly missed the overall World Cup title in 1993 and 1995 but clinched it for the first time last season. Finished third in the overall World Cup standings in 1992 and 1994.
